final_message: Cause identified from the actual PJR-8TGQ run log: the reset time was read from the first match over the entire codex output, so the echoed example 'resets 4:10am (UTC)' from .specdojo/exec-defaults.yaml (line 3630) was used instead of codex's 'try again at 11:17 PM' (line 86204). That gave a wait of about 18h, over the 28800s limit, so the wait was skipped. Fix in src/exec/limit.ts: the reset time is read per line starting from the end of the output; agy's relative 'Resets in XhYmZs' is now parsed; new decidePinnedWait gives separate skip messages for unreadable (with the original line), already passed, and exceeds the limit. src/exec/run/agent.ts uses it. Added fixed-time unit tests (8TGQ replay, crossing midnight, 12 AM/PM, agy relative, wait decisions), a CHANGELOG 0.4.0 entry, and the ticket's 対応結果 section.
